articles.title: AI Stocks Surge on Tuesday: AEHR, Fabrinet, and Lattice Semiconductor All Jump More than 10%
articles.summary:
Eric Bleeker of 24/7 Wall St. says the AI trade is showing life on Tuesday morning as a string of suppliers report strong results. The backdrop is rough: stocks in the technology, media and telecom momentum factor are down 62% from their 52-week high, a sharper correction than the dot-com bust, as hedge funds cut AI positions and money rotates into defensive areas like consumer staples.

Shares of Aehr Test Systems (NASDAQ: AEHR) are up 22%. The company makes burn-in test equipment, and sales are expected to triple this year. Fabrinet (NYSE: FN) is up 13%, with CEO Seamus Grade saying optics demand looks very sustainable. That matters after Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) announced a $115 billion buyout of Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE), a deal that sent both stocks lower. Lattice Semiconductor (NASDAQ: LSCC) also rose 13% after revenue climbed 118%. Advanced Energy (NASDAQ: AEIS) gained 10% after earnings of $3.65 beat estimates of $3.04.

Eaton (NYSE: ETN), a large supplier of electrical infrastructure for data centers, raised its full-year EPS targets and is up 7%. Bleeker's takeaway: earnings are beating expectations and point to 2027 being bigger than Wall Street expects, so watch the picks and shovels plays as earnings season continues.
